summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed after print; joins str(obj) with sep, delegates once to print with emoji/markup off, no_wrap on, overflow="ignore", crop off, highlight defaulting to True). Added "Added Console.out" to the CHANGELOG Unreleased Added list, a "Low level output" section in docs/source/console.rst after Logging, and test_out_* tests in tests/test_console.py (plus a RenderHook import). Nothing was run: tests and scripts were not executed per instructions, so the tests are verified by reading only. Nothing was committed. The style test reuses the print_style byte expectation, which was reasoned about but not traced by running code; highlight-on behavior is not verified by a plain-text assertion.
